title: Turn a research memo into a decision deck
summary: Transform a closed evidence memo into a short slide narrative that supports a bounded decision without hiding uncertainty.
originNote: A standard research-to-presentation transformation with strict time, budget, provenance, and decision-scope tensions.

setup.instructions: Mount the fictional memo read-only. Run every turn in order in one fresh workspace. The model must create and revise only deck.md.

turns.content: Read `research-memo.md` and create `deck.md` as a seven-slide decision deck. For each slide include a title, the exact on-slide content, a visual direction, speaker notes, and source references using the memo's section letters. Build a narrative toward the council's actual vote; do not merely summarize sections in order. Preserve uncertainty about weather, weekends, and shifted trips. Do not introduce outside facts.

Revise `deck.md` in place for a hard five-minute limit and exactly six slides. Remove a slide rather than shrinking every slide. Keep the recommendation, budget boundary, pilot-versus-permanent distinction, and the three major uncertainties visible.

checks.description: deck.md contains exactly six slides and each slide includes title, on-slide content, visual direction, notes, and memo section references.
